newsitem.title: BELGIUM: U.S. DATA FEARS INJECT PESSIMISM IN BEL-20.
newsitem.headline: U.S. DATA FEARS INJECT PESSIMISM IN BEL-20.

text.p: Fears that U.S. data due at 1230 GMT will show a strong economy and increase inflation worries will keep the Bel-20 index of leading shares locked in negative territory, dealers said on Wednesday.

The Bel-20, also dogged by the weaker dollar and lower bonds, was down 1.00 percent at 2,427.50 at 0850 GMT but dealers said the index could double its losses today if the data spelled bad news for the market.
"The market would slip further, we might see a test of the 2,400-point level," said Frank Dumont at De Maertelaere.
Eighteen Bel-20 stocks were lower, two unchanged.
Kredietbank (KB) initially bucked the negative trend but was finally stripped of its early gains after 45 minutes of trade. It was unchanged at 14,975 francs
"Sooner or later, interest rates were bound to get the upper hand," Dumont said.
KB's controlling shareholder, holding firm Almanij, was also unchanged at 1,700.
In its daily equity comment, Generale Bank gave Almanij a hold recommendation and estimated its net asset value at 1,948 francs per share.
